turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is a park and ride worth it? I drive in every day and parking costs a fortune.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Often, yes. You park on the edge of town for a flat fee and a bus takes you into the centre, usually with its own lanes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Tomorrow's the rail strike and I've got a job interview across the city at ten, Moshi.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Stressful timing. There's a replacement bus service, or you could take a bike from the share scheme. Which do you trust more?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Roman, what time does Grandpa usually go to bed?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: Around half nine, after the quiz show.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on a minute, I want to ask Daniel something first. Don't jump in until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Daniel, can you help me figure out the food?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure. Are we doing a meal or just snacks?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Snacks, I think. People will come and go all evening.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then a big cheese board, some dips, and maybe mini sandwiches.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And something for the vegans. Is hummus enough?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Add roasted veggies and some fruit. That's plenty.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They've gone, so we're good. Carry on.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. Getting to the interview was still the open bit. Bus, or bike?
